blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Most parts of the Visayas will experience generally fair weather, with possible isolated rains and thunderstorms, while warm and humid conditions and high heat index are expected to persist on Thursday, November 5, the state weather bureau said.
